notes.title: 🛠️ Arcade Galaxy 1.3.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
🔧 Updates & Adjustments
	•	Fairness Adjustments: Skills are now disabled when uploading maps.
	•	Score & Ghost Car Recording: Only single-player mode will record scores and ghost cars; multiplayer mode will not.
	•	Improved User Experience: Mouse cursor will now auto-hide during gameplay for better immersion.
	•	UI Enhancements: Adjusted room list UI and added keybinding explanations.

🐛 Bug Fixes
	•	Fixed various UI display errors.
	•	Resolved multiple in-game bugs for a more stable experience.

Update now and enjoy a smoother gaming experience! 🚀
